name: multi-nation-input
description: International phone input with country picker and validation. Works on React Native (iOS/Android) and web via react-native-web.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.js index.d.ts README.md dist/ && cp -R src dist/
scripts.example:install: npm install --prefix example/web --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --prefix example/web-form --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --prefix example/mobile
scripts.example:web: npm run example:install && npm run dev --prefix example/web
scripts.example:web-form: npm install --prefix example/web-form --legacy-peer-deps && npm run dev --prefix example/web-form
scripts.demo:build: npm install --prefix example/web-form --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build --prefix example/web-form
scripts.demo:preview: npm run demo:build && npm run preview --prefix example/web-form
scripts.example:mobile: npm run example:install && npm run start --prefix example/mobile
scripts.example:all: npm run example:install && concurrently -n web,mobile -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix example/web" "npm run start --prefix example/mobile"

author: Vikash Kumar
